title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Desai
description: Context: Add a first-pass set of RAG agent templates, a set of tool-calling examples for agents (HTTP connector, database lookup, and calendar integration), and updates to the docs site quickstarts to surface these samples. Motivation: make it easy for engineers to bootstrap RAG+agent workflows with production-oriented patterns (prefix caching tips, prompt templates, tool schemas) and a docs-driven quickstart path. Changes include: new example playbooks, TypeScript and Python snippets, docs site toc updates, and CI docs-preview integration. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (playbook + templates) - [x] Add tool-calling examples (http, postgres, calendar) - [x] Update docs quickstarts and TOC - [x] Add unit tests for example validation - [x] Docs preview clean on staging How to review: focus on README examples, tool schemas, and docs phrasing for recommended batching/caching settings. Related: ENG-4218, PM-134, and follow-up work tracked in ENG-4330.
commits: Add initial RAG agent templates and playbooks
Add tool-calling examples: http connector, postgres lookup, calendar integration
Docs: add quickstart pages and update TOC + sidebar
Tests: add example validation tests and CI docs preview job
Polish: fix typos, tighten prompt templates and example env setup
ci_checks: docs-preview: passed after one rerun (flaky assets)
review_comments: Ethan Chen (reviewer): 'Nice set of examples. A few calls out: 1) in postgres_lookup.ts please move the connection config to env usage pattern instead of hardcoded in example; 2) add a short note about transactions/connection pooling for Dedicated customers.'
Priya Desai (author): 'Addressed: moved DB config to env, added a paragraph about pooling and recommended pool sizes for 1-4 vCPU workers.'
Lydia Park (reviewer): 'Docs quickstart LGTM, but can we add a short section on when to choose HTTP connector vs using Redwood integrations? Otherwise users might default to HTTP for everything.'
Priya Desai (author): 'Added a short decision table to docs/guides/rag/tooling.md and linked to integrations catalog.'
Marco Rivera (reviewer): 'CI flaky on docs-preview initially; reran and it passed. Can we add a smoke check that the examples compile for both TS and Python? Otherwise examples diverge over time.'
Priya Desai (author): 'Added lightweight example validation tests under tests/examples and CI step to run them; see tests/examples/test_rag_playbooks.py.'
Reviewer approval comments: 'Ethan Chen approved', 'Lydia Park approved', 'Marco Rivera approved'
merge_summary: Squash merge of feature/docs/rag-agent-templates-tool-calling into main; final commit message consolidates PR description and lists key files added.
release_notes: Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling example quickstarts: HTTP connector, Postgres lookup, and Calendar integration. Docs quickstarts updated to include decision guidance and recommended batching/caching defaults. Example validation tests added to CI.
